title: Decem Theses open: Francus vernacular compendium of Annotatio I — subjoined to his polemical tract
pass_a_gloss: A brief Compendium of the preceding Annotation, as being a little more prolix, long since comprehended in Ten Theses, in our Vernacular, by the most Excellent sometime Doctor and Theological Professor of this University, B. Gregorius Gregorii Francus, and Subjoined to a certain Polemical Tract of his, written out in public types.
pass_b_english: Here is a short compendium of the preceding Annotation — which ran a little long — cast long ago into Ten Theses in our vernacular by the late excellent doctor and theology professor of this University, B. Gregorius Gregorii Francus, and printed as an appendix to one of his polemical tracts.
source_text: Annotationis praecedentis, utpotè paulò prolixioris breve Compendium, jampridem, Decem Thesibus, in Vernacula nostra, ab Excellentissimo quondam hujus Universitatis Doctore & Professore Theologo, B. Gregorio Gregorii Franco, comprehensum, ac Tractatui cuidam suo Polemico, publicis typis exscripto, Subjunctum.
